description: Average the stored season-to-date running win count over each country's standings rows.

b.request: For each circuit country, average `constructorStandings.wins` across all standings rows for races held there, using the stored season-to-date win counts; keep countries whose average exceeds both the overall average across all standings rows and the average of the countries that exceed that overall average; return one row with the unrounded mean of the kept countries’ averages, their mean excess over the overall average, and their mean excess over the above-average countries’ average
b.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings), above_average AS (SELECT AVG(ca.avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins) SELECT AVG(ca.avg_wins) AS mean_country_average, AVG(ca.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_overall, AVG(ca.avg_wins - aa.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_above_average FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN above_average AS aa WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins AND ca.avg_wins > aa.avg_wins;

a.request: Link constructor standings to their races and circuits. For each circuit country, compute the average of `constructorStandings.wins` as stored (the season-to-date running count of wins) across that country's standings rows. Keep the countries whose average is above the mean of all country averages, and note how far each is above it. Among those, keep the countries whose average is also above the mean of the kept countries' averages, and note how far each is above that second mean. Return one row with three unrounded values: the mean of these final countries' average wins, the mean of their excess over the all-country mean, and the mean of their excess over the above-average group's mean.
a.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), all_country_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_wins FROM country_averages), above_average AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN all_country_mean AS am WHERE ca.average_wins > am.mean_wins), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_wins FROM above_average) SELECT AVG(aa.average_wins) AS mean_final_average_wins, AVG(aa.average_wins - am.mean_wins) AS mean_excess_over_all_countries, AVG(aa.average_wins - aam.mean_wins) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_countries FROM above_average AS aa CROSS JOIN all_country_mean AS am CROSS JOIN above_average_mean AS aam WHERE aa.average_wins > aam.mean_wins;

c.request: For each country where races are held, look at the average constructor wins per standings entry at its races. Take the countries above the overall average, and then those of them that are also above the average of that above-average group. Give one row with three unrounded figures: the mean of those countries' average wins, the mean of how far they exceed the overall average, and the mean of how far they exceed the above-average group's average. Average the stored season-to-date running win count over each country's standings rows.
c.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.avg_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(ca.avg_wins) AS mean_country_avg_wins, AVG(ca.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_overall, AVG(ca.avg_wins - g.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_above_average_group FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins AND ca.avg_wins > g.avg_wins;

d.request: For each country where races are held, average the stored season-to-date constructor win count across its standings rows. Find the countries whose averages exceed the overall average, then keep those whose averages also exceed the average of that above-average group. Return one row with three unrounded figures: the mean of the remaining countries’ averages, their mean excess over the overall average, and their mean excess over the above-average group’s average.
d.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), above_average AS (SELECT ca.avg_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_average) SELECT AVG(ca.avg_wins) AS mean_country_average, AVG(ca.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_overall, AVG(ca.avg_wins - aam.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_above_average_group FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN above_average_mean AS aam WHERE ca.avg_wins > aam.avg_wins;
